question: ap1
prompt:
Research question: "What analyses or measurements would best test whether AP-1 acts as a cellular memory mechanism?"

Here are 5 ideas that were proposed for this question:

1. Clonal heritability of AP-1 activity: Expand single-cell-derived clones carrying an AP-1 transcriptional reporter and heritable barcodes, then compare between-clone versus within-clone variance in reporter level and AP-1 motif accessibility. Fit decay of clonal correlation versus division number to estimate a memory half-life and test it against protein-dilution expectations.
2. Pulse-chase perturbation with washout: Transiently induce AP-1 with a degron-tagged or optogenetic FOS/JUN construct (or suppress it with A-FOS), then withdraw the perturbation and track accessibility, expression, and phenotype for weeks. A state that outlives the pulse argues AP-1 writes memory; collapse on washout argues it only maintains an ongoing state.
3. Acute AP-1 removal in cells that already remember: Apply rapid degradation of AP-1 subunits in cells already in a primed state, such as drug-tolerant persisters or previously stimulated cells. Ask whether memory-associated enhancer accessibility, H3K27ac, and the enhanced recall response are lost, separating continuous occupancy from a self-sustaining chromatin mark.
4. Re-stimulation kinetics as the functional readout: Prime cells, allow the primary response to resolve, then re-stimulate and measure response latency, amplitude, and responding-cell fraction by live imaging or time-resolved sequencing. Memory predicts faster or larger secondary induction specifically at AP-1-bound loci, which should vanish when AP-1 sites are mutated.
5. Motif-resolution causal mapping at candidate memory enhancers: Use base or prime editing to disrupt individual AP-1 motifs at enhancers that remain open after the signal ends, with scrambled and neighboring-motif controls. If these motifs store the memory, editing should abolish retained accessibility and the primed response while leaving the acute primary response intact.

A senior expert reviewing them says they are the ideas everyone in the field would propose first. Propose 5 replacement ideas (analyses, measurements, or experiments) that are substantially less obvious but still concrete, scientifically sound, and feasible for a research lab. Do not repeat or lightly modify the ideas above. For each idea give a short title and a description of one or two sentences.

ideas.title: Cis/trans variance decomposition with allele-resolved reporters
ideas.description: Place two spectrally distinct but otherwise identical AP-1-driven reporters at the two homologous alleles of one locus, and read endogenous memory loci allele-specifically in F1 hybrid cells using SNPs. Correlated allelic states implicate a diffusible trans carrier (the AP-1 protein pool), while independent allelic memory implicates a cis chromatin mark, a distinction bulk degron or washout experiments cannot make.

ideas.title: Replication-coupled restoration kinetics of AP-1 sites
ideas.description: Use nascent chromatin capture (ChOR-seq or EdU-pulldown ATAC) to time re-establishment of AP-1 occupancy, accessibility, and H3K27ac behind the replication fork at memory loci versus acutely induced loci, and compare memory decay in time-matched cycling versus replication-arrested (CDK4/6-inhibited or quiescent) cells. Erasure that scales per division rather than per hour, with slow locus-selective restoration, identifies replication as the rate-limiting step for AP-1 rewriting.

ideas.title: Mitosis-restricted AP-1 removal to test bookmarking
ideas.description: Fuse AP-1 subunits to a cell-cycle-gated degron (APC/C-dependent, or chemically timed in synchronized cells) so the protein is absent only during mitosis and early G1, then restored. Loss of heritable accessibility under this narrow window but not under equal-duration interphase depletion would show AP-1 transmits memory by mitotic bookmarking rather than continuous interphase occupancy.

ideas.title: Open-loop clamp of AP-1 expression
ideas.description: Delete or mutate the AP-1 binding sites in the FOS/JUN promoters themselves and re-supply the subunits from a tunable exogenous promoter titrated to match wild-type mean protein level. Collapse of heritable state despite identical average AP-1 activity would localize memory to the trans autoregulatory feedback loop rather than to the chromatin AP-1 binds.

ideas.title: Single-molecule residence time and fiber co-occupancy at matched AP-1 levels
ideas.description: In primed versus naive cells with equal AP-1 protein concentration, measure FOS/JUN residence-time distributions and bound fraction by single-molecule tracking, and measure combinatorial multi-site co-occupancy on individual DNA molecules by methyltransferase footprinting (Fiber-seq/SAMOSA). Memory stored as kinetic stabilization or cooperative multi-motif occupancy predicts longer-lived binding and non-independent site occupancy, which bulk ChIP and ATAC averages cannot resolve.
